MORE: In pursuance to the provisions of Regulation 30 (read with Part A of Schedule III) and Regulation 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today have inter alia considered and approved the Standalone Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. Please find attached a copy of the said financial results along with Limited Review Report as received from the Statutory Auditors of the Company.
